abilities.desc_zh: 近战攻击散发白热聚变辐射，刀刀见血，造成辐射撕裂 (Radiation Bleed) 与重度破甲。
abilities.desc_en: Melee strikes glow with white-hot solar radiation, causing Radiation Bleed and heavy Armor Break.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击命中 100% 概率施加一层燃烧减益，造成攻击力 50% 的伤害，持续 4.5 秒。暴击命中时 50% 概率额外施加一层燃烧减益，造成攻击力 30% 的伤害，持续 4 秒。当对手处于燃烧减益状态时，其规避几率降低 35%。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks: 100% chance to inflict Burn, dealing 50% Attack over 4.5s. Critical Hits: 50% chance to inflict Burn, dealing 30% Attack over 4s. While the opponent has a Burn Debuff, their chance to Evade is reduced by 35%.

abilities.desc_zh: 当生命值高于 40% 时，体内失控的恒星反应堆过热，每秒扣除自身 0.5% 生命值；作为代价，每扣除累计 10% 生命值，获得一层持续到战斗结束的 [10% - 18%] 近战增益（上限 4 层）。当生命值降至 40% 及以下时，停止扣除自身生命值，并保留已获得的全部近战增益。
abilities.desc_en: While Health is above 40%, his unstable fusion core overloads, consuming 0.5% of his own Health per second; in return, gains a permanent [10% - 18%] Melee Buff for every 10% Health consumed (Max Stacks: 4). When Health drops to 40% or below, stops consuming Health and retains all accumulated Melee Buffs.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击命中 100% 几率施加一层燃烧减益，造成攻击力 45% 的伤害，持续 4 秒；技能结束后获得一个暴击增益，增加 25% 暴击率，持续 4 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to inflict Burn dealing 45% Attack over 4s; grants a 25% Critical Chance Buff for 4s after the Special ends.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击命中 80% 几率施加 2 层燃烧减益，造成攻击力 60% 的伤害，持续 5 秒；并有 50% 概率造成眩晕，持续 1.5 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 80% chance to inflict 2 stacks of Burn dealing 60% Attack over 5s; 50% chance to inflict Stun for 1.5s.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击命中 100% 几率施加 3 层燃烧减益，造成攻击力 90% 的伤害，持续 6 秒；技能结束后获得一个暴击伤害增益，增加 35% 暴击伤害，持续 6 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to inflict 3 stacks of Burn dealing 90% Attack over 6s; grants a 35% Crit Damage Buff for 6s after the Special ends.

abilities.desc_zh: 与雷震、震天尊同队时，破甲效果提升 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Armor Piercing when teamed with Bludgeon or Megatronus.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛同队时，获得 +{{var_2}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Critical Damage when teamed with Starscream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Critical Damage.
